questions.q: 研究生院的核心工作是甚麼？
choices: 統籌研究生教育的管理、發展及評估
代替教授決定所有研究題目
questions.why: 研究生院與學術單位合作，統籌研究生教育的管理、發展及評估。

questions.q: 研究生院公開資料顯示哪一組行政工作分工？
choices: 校車維修、餐廳營運及保安
招生及推廣、學籍管理、課程及學術支援
所有本科院系的考試出題
questions.why: 研究生院聯絡頁列有這三類工作小組。

questions.q: 查詢澳大研究生院的一般官方電郵是甚麼？
questions.why: 研究生院官方聯絡電郵為 gradschool@um.edu.mo。

questions.q: 研究生院的招生資訊包括哪些課程層次？
choices: 博士、碩士及部分學士後證書／文憑課程
questions.why: 官網列有博士、碩士及學士後證書／文憑課程資訊。

questions.q: 澳大博士普通招生途徑一般要求甚麼學歷？
choices: 碩士學位或澳大認可的同等學歷
questions.why: 博士普通招生一般要求碩士學位或認可的同等學歷。

questions.q: 申請澳大博士課程，哪種做法最符合官方程序？
choices: 由校外補習社直接保證取錄
按照官方規定經網上申請系統提交
questions.why: 研究生院提供官方網上申請系統，入學決定須經正式程序。

questions.q: 現行澳大博士生獎學金UMPS適用於何時起入學的學生？
choices: 任何人入學即自動獲獎
questions.why: UMPS列明適用於2023/24學年起入學的學生，亦須經甄選。

questions.q: UMPS的每月津貼和最長年期為何？
questions.why: UMPS公布每月澳門元20,000，最長四年。

questions.q: UMPS最終獲獎結果由誰決定？
choices: 大學層面的遴選委員會
questions.why: UMPS由大學層面遴選委員會作最終決定。

questions.q: UMTRA A類教研助理起始每月津貼是多少？
questions.why: UMTRA A類起始津貼為每月澳門元12,500。

questions.q: UMTRA除了支援博士學習，還與哪類實務有關？
choices: 參與教學及研究的輔助工作
負責替教授核准整個學位
questions.why: UMTRA協助博士生參與教學及研究相關的輔助工作。

questions.q: 澳大國際碩士生獎學金主要面向哪一類申請人？
choices: 符合條件、持有效外國護照的全日制碩士申請人
questions.why: 國際碩士獎學金適用於符合條件的全日制非高管類碩士課程申請人。

questions.q: 澳大STEM碩士獎學金的基本安排是甚麼？
choices: 合資格本地STEM碩士生獲自動考慮，屬一次性獎學金
所有學科學生固定每月獲四年資助
必須到海外辦公室提交申請
questions.why: STEM獎學金針對合資格的本地STEM碩士生，獎學金為一次性。

questions.q: 研究生院公布的部分內地合作機構聯合博士培養計劃，通常如何分配學習年期？
choices: 首年澳大，其後三年合作機構
在合作機構修讀十年後方可入學
questions.why: 相關聯合博士計劃通常首年於澳大，其後三年於合作機構學習。

questions.q: 完成研究生院所列的內地機構聯合博士計劃後，由誰授予博士學位？
choices: 所有合作院校必然各發一個學位
questions.why: 該聯合博士培養安排由雙方共同指導，完成註冊課程後由澳大頒發博士學位。

questions.q: 2026/27學年橫琴第一期辦學點的具體上課安排由誰確定？
choices: 學生自行決定全部上課地點
questions.why: 研究生院列明由相關學術單位決定並於入學時通知。

questions.q: 如何正確理解現階段橫琴第一期辦學與未來新校區？
choices: 新校區早在2020年全面完工
第一期已安排教學；新校區預計2028年部分啟用、2029年全面建成
澳門主校區自2026年停止全部教學
questions.why: 第一期辦學與正在建設的新合作區校區是不同階段。

questions.q: 研究生院在讀學生欄目提供哪類資訊？
choices: 規章與指引、學歷文件及離校相關手續
全澳門公務員招募表格
其他大學員工的人事考核
questions.why: 研究生院提供與研究生學籍、學術規章及文件申請相關的資訊。

questions.q: 新五年規劃預計2030/31學年全校研究生佔比約為多少？
questions.why: 規劃預計2030/31學年研究生佔全校學生約55%。

questions.q: 五年規劃表6預計2030/31學年研究生總數是多少？
questions.why: 表6預計2030/31學年全校研究生共12,324人。

questions.q: 2030/31學年澳大預計總學生人數是多少？
questions.why: 五年規劃表6預計2030/31學年總學生人數為22,211人。

questions.q: 五年規劃預計全校研究生住宿書院合計設有多少間？
questions.why: 計劃在澳門主校區與合作區校區各設三間研究生書院，總共六間。

questions.q: 哪一組是五年規劃提出的研究生住宿書院主題？
choices: 創新與跨領域交流、卓越研究、全球交流
純校車駕駛、體育博彩及酒店採購
全部只辦本科軍事訓練
questions.why: 規劃列出創新與跨領域交流、卓越研究、全球交流等研究生書院主題。

questions.q: 五年規劃指出拓展國際碩士生源，可加強哪些亞洲市場？
questions.why: 五年規劃第26頁舉出馬來西亞、越南等亞洲國家作為重點拓展方向。

questions.q: 研究生管理數碼化改革提出哪項具體措施？
choices: 線上論文典試委員會提交及畢業生職業發展追踪模塊
questions.why: 規劃提出優化研究生管理系統，加入線上提交及畢業生職涯追踪。

questions.q: How does the Graduate School work with academic units?
choices: It replaces supervisors in all research decisions
It coordinates the management and development of postgraduate education
questions.why: GRS works with academic units on the management, development and evaluation of graduate education.

questions.q: When should applicants normally apply for the UM PhD Scholarship?
choices: Only after graduating from the PhD
At the same time as their online PhD admission application
Through an unrelated private social-media account
questions.why: UMPS applications are submitted together with the online PhD application.

questions.q: For which entry semester are UMPS and UMTRA applications available, according to GRS?
questions.why: The GRS funding pages specify first-semester admission for these funding applications.

questions.q: Which cohort distinction is correct?
choices: UMPS is only for bachelor's students
Both scholarship names were introduced for the first time in 2026
UMPS applies from 2023/24 admission; the older Macao PhD Scholarship applies to earlier cohorts
questions.why: The funding pages distinguish eligibility by the year of admission.

questions.q: How is the stipend of UMTRA Type B calculated?
choices: A fixed MOP40,000 per month for everyone
It equals the monthly average of full tuition fees over the normal study period
questions.why: UMTRA Type B is tied to the monthly average of the programme's full tuition fee.

questions.q: What is offered under Type B of the International Student Scholarship for Master's students?
questions.why: Type B covers 100% of the master's programme tuition fee.

questions.q: What does Type C of the International Student Scholarship waive?
choices: The international tuition differential, allowing payment at the local tuition rate
All tuition, housing and travel for four years
questions.why: Type C removes the international tuition differential.

questions.q: Must eligible international master's applicants submit a separate scholarship application?
choices: Yes, only a paper form is accepted
Only after tuition is paid in full
No, eligible students are considered automatically during admission evaluation
questions.why: The GRS page states that a separate scholarship application is not required.

questions.q: Who may qualify for UM's STEM Scholarship for master's study?
choices: Eligible Macao identity-card holders admitted to STEM master's programmes
Any tourist taking a day trip to Macao
Only employees enrolled in non-degree classes
questions.why: The STEM scholarship targets eligible local master's students in related disciplines.

questions.q: How do partner-recommended applicants apply for the listed Joint PhD Programmes?
choices: They enrol at the partner without any UM procedures
They only need a verbal promise from a friend
They apply through UM's online system during the stated period
questions.why: Joint PhD applicants recommended by partners still submit applications via UM's online system.

questions.q: How are research supervisors arranged under the listed Joint PhD Programmes?
choices: Supervisors from UM and the partner jointly supervise students
Only a funding sponsor determines the student's research
questions.why: Joint PhD students receive joint supervision from both institutions.

questions.q: What funding range is stated for UM's listed Joint PhD Programmes?
choices: No funding of any kind may be offered
questions.why: The GRS page specifies monthly support of MOP6,250–12,500 under these agreements.

questions.q: Which discipline appears among the 2026/27 Hengqin first-phase postgraduate arrangements?
questions.why: The GRS Hengqin page lists AI, IoT, finance, engineering, public health and other fields.

questions.q: Who determines the teaching location for relevant 2026/27 postgraduate programmes?
choices: The first person to email the university
questions.why: Class arrangements are determined by the academic unit and conveyed upon enrolment.

questions.q: Which online learning platform is shared in the Hengqin first-phase arrangements?
questions.why: The GRS page confirms unified UMMoodle access.

questions.q: Which statement best describes classes in the 2026/27 Hengqin first-phase arrangements?
choices: All postgraduate teaching has moved permanently out of Macao
Depending on the programme, classes may be held at the Hengqin site and the main campus
The Macao main campus has closed
questions.why: GRS lists Hengqin daytime classes and main-campus daytime or evening classes, subject to programme arrangements.

questions.q: When is the new Hengqin Cooperation Zone campus expected to open partly and be completed?
questions.why: The five-year plan envisages partial opening in 2028 and completion in 2029.

questions.q: What student population is projected for the cooperation-zone campus in 2030/31?
questions.why: Table 6 of the five-year plan forecasts 3,967 students at the cooperation-zone campus.

questions.q: How many postgraduate students are forecast at that campus in 2030/31?
questions.why: The five-year plan projects 2,742 postgraduate students at the cooperation-zone campus.

questions.q: How many residential colleges in total are envisaged across both campuses?
questions.why: The new five-year plan sets out 20 residential colleges across both campuses.

questions.q: How many postgraduate residential colleges are included in that plan?
questions.why: The plan sets out three postgraduate colleges on each campus, six in all.

questions.q: What is a key postgraduate recruitment priority in UM's five-year plan?
choices: Expand international enrolment in master's programmes
questions.why: The plan prioritises international master's recruitment and improved admission processes.

questions.q: Which recruitment approach is proposed in the five-year plan?
choices: Remove experiential activities from information sessions
Target universities, promote specific programmes and add experiential elements to events
questions.why: The plan suggests targeted outreach and experience-based recruitment activities.

questions.q: What additional component does the plan propose for doctoral education?
choices: A translational research unit in PhD programmes
Replacing all research with leisure activities
questions.why: The plan proposes incorporating translational research into doctoral programmes.

questions.q: What should a university-level doctoral research exchange programme enable?
choices: Participation in national academic and world-class industry research projects
Automatic degrees from all overseas universities
questions.why: The plan proposes doctoral exchanges linked to national projects and leading industry research.
